title: SEAF: Selective Semantic Enrichment and Visual Evidence Fusion for Multimodal Sarcasm Detection
abstract: arXiv:2611.25672v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Multimodal sarcasm detection requires textual, visual, and contextual evidence, particularly when multiple images provide complementary cues. Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) can generate auxiliary information from a post's text and images, but their outputs may mix useful background knowledge with redundant visual descriptions. We propose SEAF, a dual-branch framework for selective semantic enrichment and visual evidence fusion. SEAF assigns generated fields to distinct roles: entity background enriches semantic input, while image descriptions supply alignment statistics. The semantic branch combines the original post text, background from a frozen MLLM, and optical character recognition (OCR) text. The aligned visual branch combines global and local visual features with statistics of cross-modal and inter-image similarity. translated_title: SEAF：用于多模态讽刺检测的选择性语义增强与视觉证据融合
translated_abstract: 多模态讽刺检测需要文本、视觉和上下文证据，尤其是当多张图像提供互补线索时。多模态大语言模型（MLLM）能够根据帖子的文本和图像生成辅助信息，但其输出可能将有用的背景知识与冗余的视觉描述混杂在一起。我们提出了SEAF，一个用于选择性语义增强与视觉证据融合的双分支框架。SEAF将生成的字段分配给不同的角色：实体背景用于增强语义输入，而图像描述则提供对齐统计数据。语义分支结合了原始帖子文本、来自冻结MLLM的背景信息以及光学字符识别（OCR）文本。对齐的视觉分支将全局和局部视觉特征与跨模态及图像间相似性统计相结合。文本锚定平滑聚合机制（TASA）根据图像与原始帖子文本的相似度对图像进行加权。
tldr: 提出SEAF双分支框架，通过选择性语义增强和基于文本锚定加权聚合的视觉证据融合，有效利用MLLM生成的实体背景知识与多图像视觉特征，提升多模态讽刺检测性能。
en_tdlr: Proposes SEAF, a dual-branch framework that selectively enriches semantics with MLLM-generated entity background knowledge and fuses visual evidence from multiple images via text-anchored smoothed aggregation to improve multimodal sarcasm detection.
